chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr al-Bazanṭī asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام:
about a man who forgot to pronounce the opening takbir until he said the takbir for rukuʿ, so he said: “It suffices him.”

key_terms.أَجْزَأَهُ: it was sufficient for him and fulfilled the requirement

ai.seo_question: If someone forgets Takbirat al-Iftitah until the takbir for ruku' in prayer, does the salat still count?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning forgetfulness in salat (prayer). It indicates that if a person forgets the opening takbir and only remembers by the time of the takbir for ruku', that is sufficient for him.
